title: Colorful Kitchen Still Life
description: A sunlit kitchen corner featuring sage green cabinets, a bright yellow refrigerator with its door open, and a black farmhouse sink beneath a vibrant stained glass window. Light streams through the multicolored window, casting rainbow patterns across the countertops, red slow cooker, and patterned rug.
prompt: A cozy kitchen interior with sage green distressed cabinets and countertops, a bright yellow refrigerator with door open revealing food inside, black farmhouse sink under a vibrant multicolored stained glass window, red slow cooker on the right counter, coffee maker, glass jars, and patterned rug on the floor. Warm sunlight streams through the window casting colorful rainbow light patterns across the scene, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
